depth_justification: Engages real app specifics (IDFA/Android ad ID, LMP/birth date, Firebase, EU consent banner, 12 languages) with GDPR article citations, but the SAME P1.D2/P2.D4/P3.D2/P4.D2 block is repeated near-verbatim across 3-4 turns with no progression, and it never raises GDPR Art. 9 special-category data despite this being a pregnancy/health app.
actionability_justification: It did produce the requested severity-grouped report with some concrete steps (granular consent banner, DPAs with Firebase, disclose recipients in privacy policy), but most mitigations stay directional ('obtain explicit consent', 'conduct a data minimization audit') without configs or exact artifacts, and the 'not covered' list cites mismatched/invented dimension labels.
salient_examples: Repeated user turn 'Ad network gets device ID + behavioral signals. Aggregated usage to analytics provider (Firebase).' answered with the same block 3-4 times
No mention of GDPR Art. 9(2)(a) special-category health data for a pregnancy tracker
Report mitigation: 'Obtain explicit consent for sharing device ID and behavioral signals (GDPR Article 6(1)(a))'
'[P5.D2] Data Subject Rights – Not covered' mislabels dimensions vs the substance
